page: Microsoft Azure E32-16ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine utilizing the x86_64 architecture under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It runs on an Intel Xeon 8573C processor clocked at up to 4.2 GHz, configured with 8 physical cores and 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. The CPU features 260 MB of L3 cache alongside hardware support for Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 vector instructions. Memory capacity is substantial at 256 GB, yielding 16 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance includes 1890 GB of bundled local NVMe SSD storage and operates without discrete GPU hardware.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-threaded CPU capability, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2112.0 placing in the upper performance tier, complemented by a multi-core score of 13078.0. In memory throughput tests, the instance records uncached read bandwidth of 120.69 GB/sec and uncached write throughput of 67.63 GB/sec, alongside a cached small-block read speed of 1241.63 GB/sec. Data processing throughput remains balanced across workloads, evidenced by 22.61 million Redis SET operations per second and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rates reaching 103.27 GB/sec.

The constrained vCPU design of the E32-16ds_v6 allows organizations to leverage high per-core memory density and integrated NVMe storage without incurring the software licensing costs associated with higher core counts. Because compute parallelization is capped at 16 vCPUs, the instance represents a clear tradeoff favoring memory capacity over extreme multi-threaded scalability. This hardware configuration is appropriate for relational databases like PostgreSQL and SQL Server, in-memory caches like Redis, ETL data transformations, and memory-intensive enterprise analytics.
description: Microsoft Azure E32-16ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from constrained core counts to lower software licensing expenses. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at up to 4.2 GHz, the instance delivers 16 dedicated vCPUs across 8 physical cores, 260 MB of L3 cache, and hardware support for AVX-512 and AMX instructions. It features 256 GB of system RAM, providing an elevated 16 GB of memory per vCPU, paired with 1890 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark results show strong single-core performance with a Geekbench score of 2112.0 and 22.61 million Redis SET operations per second. While parallel processing capacity is constrained by the 16-thread allocation, the extensive memory footprint and rapid NVMe scratch space make the E32-16ds_v6 well suited for enterprise database servers, in-memory caching tiers, large-scale ETL pipelines, and transactional business applications.
